title: RMB UTCT — official UT100 2026 race page
claims: The 2026 UT100 is listed at 99.1 km, 5,000 m D+, a 26-hour cut-off and 9 aid stations, starting and finishing at Gardens Rugby Club at 04:00 on 21 November 2026.
The UT100 course description calls the route front-loaded, with two significant climbs on Table Mountain and Karbonkelberg within the first 50 km and 4,972 m of elevation gain.
The official UT100 page publishes a downloadable GPX for the 2026 route.
The official race-information page says the event is cupless and that runners must carry their own cup; it also sets the minimum age for UT100 at 20.
The official UT100 page calls UT100 the final race of the Gran Canaria World Trail Majors and one of the event's original distances.
The 2026 UT100 open prize money is R75,000 for first, R37,500 for second and R18,750 for third.

The Nic Bornman Medal goes to the top ten men and women of UT100; The Originals medal goes to anyone finishing UT100 under 15 hours, recalling the inaugural 2014 race where only 14 people finished under a 15-hour cut-off.

verification.note: 2026-11-20 经本机 7890 代理读取官方 UT100 页、GPX 链接与 race-info 页；页面并给出 UT100 是 WTM 最后一站、2026 奖金、Nic Bornman 与 The Originals 奖牌说明。GPX 已下载并逐点计算，页面不重新分发文件。
